payload.summary: src/lib/supabase/admin.ts and src/lib/openai.ts construct privileged clients without the server-only import guard
payload.detail: Add import "server-only"; to both files. Why: no 'use client' file imports either today (verified by grep, so there is no live leak), but without the guard a future accidental client import is caught by discipline rather than by the build failing — and the blast radius is the service-role key and the OpenAI key. src/lib/env.ts already carries the guard, so this is consistency with an existing pattern. Owner: assistant. Confidence: high — verified absent 2026-09-20. Depends on: nothing.
